_comment: mapping values: exact | equivalent | approximated | unsupported | custom_macro | not_applicable | review. 'p1' text makes the tool a P1 blocker. 'trap' adds a note to the behaviour-difference appendix. Macro patterns are regexes matched against the .yxmc file name.

DbFileInput.savant: Dataset / connected system source (+ Adapter for names and types)
DbFileInput.p1: Connection or dataset must exist in the target workspace; Savvy cannot create credentialed connections

DbFileOutput.savant: Destination (CSV native; OneDrive/Google Drive/Snowflake write-back via connected system)

AlteryxSelect.savant: Transform (rename / retype / hide) — usually folded into a neighbouring Transform

Formula.trap: IF/CASE with computed branches becomes flag * value or COALESCE; integer types truncate

MultiRowFormula.savant: Transform window calc (LAG/LEAD/CUM_SUM) partitioned by group, sorted

MultiFieldFormula.savant: Transform — one calculated column per field

Filter.savant: Filter (wizard or expression); False branch via false path

Summarize.savant: Summarize (group by + aggregations); Count -> COUNT(Row), CountDistinct -> NUNIQUE, First/Last -> deterministic rank

Join.savant: Blend (inner/left/right/full); L/J/R outputs via unmatched forks
Join.trap: case-sensitive string keys, duplicate-key row explosion

Unique.savant: Deduplicate on fields (with sort for deterministic survivor)
Unique.trap: Duplicates output anchor = second and later occurrences only; Savant 'include duplicates' flags all members of a duplicate group

Sort.savant: Not a step — sorting is applied where it matters (window sorts, dedupe sorts, destination sort)

AppendFields.savant: Blend on a constant key (cartesian) or window MAX/MIN for single-row appends

FindReplace.savant: Search and Replace, or Blend + COALESCE for lookup mode

GenerateRows.savant: Scaffold via Summarize + constant-key Blend, or Split

DownloadData.p1: Endpoint auth must be configured in Savant

PythonTool.savant: No code steps — rebuild logic with native steps or GenAI
PythonTool.p1: Python tool logic must be re-expressed with native steps

RTool.savant: No code steps — rebuild logic with native steps
RTool.p1: R tool logic must be re-expressed with native steps

RunCommand.p1: Run Command has no Savant equivalent

BrowseV2.savant: Not needed — every step has a preview

Browse.savant: Not needed — every step has a preview

TextBox.savant: Step / group descriptions (or an app text prompt → runtime parameter)

TableauOutput.p1: Land the table in Snowflake or a file store and repoint Tableau

PublishToTableauServer.p1: Land the table in Snowflake or a file store and repoint Tableau

FileBrowse.savant: Analytic-app input: user-selected file becomes the flow's dataset (upload / cloud folder / scheduled drop)

Tab.savant: Analytic-app UI layout — no equivalent needed

Action.savant: Analytic-app wiring (Update Value) — becomes the dataset binding or a parameter

DropDown.savant: Analytic-app choice → filter value / parameter; confirm how it is supplied at run time

publishtotableau.savant: No Tableau publish — land in Snowflake or file store, repoint Tableau
publishtotableau.p1: Replace Tableau publish with a supported destination and repoint the workbooks

tableau.p1: Replace Tableau publish with a supported destination

iterative|batch.savant: Loop — redesign as scaffold + join or Split/Explode
iterative|batch.p1: Iterative/batch macro needs a loop-free redesign
